confidence_upgrades.installation: Kirkby Thore manufacturing site / British Gypsum Kirkby Thore
confidence_upgrades.reason: The Cumberland/Enterprising Cumbria public profile already reported 38,414 tCO2 for 2019. Part66 independently matched the Net Zero North West one-site gypsum/plasterboard value of 38,414 tCO2e to Kirkby Thore through its unique narrative that the site manufactures Thistle plasters continuously since 1910, which British Gypsum's official Kirkby Thore page states explicitly. Historic official-statistics Pollution Inventory material also preserves Kirkby Thore point-source/permit references RP3033KW and BM5852IF. Direct EC/EEA 2019 installation-row readback and a current manufacturing permit are still absent, so confidence remains below 99 and no measured promotion occurs.

reconciliations.reason: Net Zero North West explicitly mixes EU ETS 2019 sites with NAEI 2017 sites. The 184,116 t lime single-site figure closely tracks the official-statistics Pollution Inventory Shap/Corus series ending at 184.24 kt in 2017. It is therefore treated as a 2017 NAEI diagnostic rather than a second 2019 value. The existing 2019 194,549 t candidate remains confidence 98.

Environment Agency confirms the BJ7611IY permit family and a 2020 V009 variation at Barrow Paper Mill. A local-authority-hosted environmental search also records the original permit family as effective through 31 January 2019, but a successor variation covering the remainder of 2019 was not established in this pass. The candidate therefore stays at 97 rather than being over-upgraded.

screened_not_promoted.reason: Net Zero North West's one-site iron/steel narrative describes about 500,000 tonnes of metallic-coated/pre-finished steel, matching Tata Steel Shotton. Tata's official site places Shotton at Deeside, North Wales, outside the England slot.

Net Zero North West reports one airport site at 6,648 tCO2e, but its table combines EU ETS 2019 and NAEI 2017 sources and the site row's source year is not explicitly resolved. No 2019 facility candidate is inferred.
The report has one asphalt site at 4,824 tCO2e, but the site identity and whether the figure belongs to the 2019 ETS or 2017 NAEI side are not proven.
